_comment: Template for config/sources.json — the news sources your collectors read. Copy to config/sources.json and list your own. kind: official | media | research. tier: 1 primary/official, 2 quality media, 3 niche. region: default region for items when the text gives no signal (US, EA, UK, JP, CN, CA, AU, NZ, CH, SE, NO, Global). topics: default topic hints. Only titles, short summaries and links should be stored; respect each source's terms of use.
